items.title: Редактор блокирует существующие характеристики у 208 товаров
checks: Frontend schema and editor regression: 4 tests passed; distinct d/D specifications preserved.

items.title: Калькулятор кабеля возвращает рекомендацию за пределами своей таблицы
checks: 6 advisor API tests passed, including both materials above the supported range; capacity and specialist state returned.

items.title: Рекомендации товаров не соответствуют параметрам калькуляторов
checks: 8 advisor regressions and explicit bundle selection test passed; material, nominal and curve matched using supplier aliases; arbitrary power products removed.

items.title: Калькулятор расходует лимит расчёта корзины
checks: 10 advisor tests and 2 UI regressions passed; dedicated rate limit, one debounced cancellable request, coordinated cable/breaker capacity and pole matching.
Full frontend suite passed (116 tests) after allowing the debounced asynchronous result 3 seconds under parallel test load; request count/cancellation assertions unchanged.

items.title: Корзина принимает дробное количество, которое API отклоняет
checks: 4 cart regressions passed, including persisted fractional quantities; one integer normalizer shared by cart and product controls; typecheck and lint passed.

items.title: Корзина разрешает больше строк, чем контракт checkout
checks: 11 cart, checkout and advisor regressions passed; limit 100 lines enforced, bundle additions atomic, oversized persisted carts retained for manual editing.

items.title: Цена в боковой корзине может устареть
checks: 14 cart/checkout regressions passed; opening the cart refreshes current product metadata without changing quantities or removing unavailable lines, checkout renders server quote unit prices; TypeScript/lint passed.
End-to-end cart assertion now checks the estimated sum label; final payable total remains authoritative in checkout.

items.title: При возврате к закэшированному товару исчезает фото
checks: Gallery regressions passed for cached navigation, shrinking media and failed derivatives/originals; product content keyed by identity resets quantity, tab and review state; typecheck/lint passed.

items.title: Canonical и description остаются от предыдущего товара
checks: 3 metadata regressions passed; all title-only pages update canonical/description and clear previous product data; Open Graph fields updated; duplicate title effects removed; typecheck/lint passed.

items.title: Номер страницы допускает переполнение SQL OFFSET
checks: 2 pagination regressions passed; OpenAPI page bounds guarantee OFFSET fits signed BIGINT at every supported page size; overflowing requests return 422.

items.title: Мобильный поиск сбрасывает фильтры
checks: Mobile catalog search regression passed: repeated brands, specifications and sort retained while pagination resets; TypeScript and lint passed.

items.title: Смена условий оставляет старые карточки без признака обновления
checks: 2 catalog UI regressions passed: old cards marked aria-busy during filter changes, pending status visible, background failures show retry; typecheck/lint passed.

items.title: Обещание отслеживания гостевого заказа ведёт в недоступную историю
checks: 7 checkout/success-page regressions passed; guests get order-number instructions, history link only for orders created in an authenticated account; selected delivery method preserved.

items.title: Несогласованные тексты доставки, возврата и оплаты
checks: Checkout regression asserts truthful payment text; shipping/return placeholders and unsupported payment-gateway promise removed; typecheck and lint passed.

items.title: Контракт изменения media меньше существующих галерей
checks: Gallery contract regression passed: 22 ordered images accepted without truncation; write limit raised to 100 to match existing galleries while remaining bounded.

items.title: Счётчики посетителей неустойчивы к параллельности и повтору заказа
checks: 17 activity/order tests passed; SQL increments are atomic and idempotent order retries do not count a second contact; added PostgreSQL concurrency regression.
PostgreSQL integration: 50 concurrent first visits and 50 contacts accumulated exactly 50/50, including creation races; full backend suite 333 passed.

items.title: Прямые HTML-ответы не содержат данных страницы; несуществующий URL отдаёт 200
checks: 15 backend HTML/API contract tests passed; meaningful public HTML with canonical/Open Graph/JSON-LD, exact 404/422/503 statuses, escaped supplier data and script-safe JSON; nginx syntax validated. 6 local browser routes passed; robots metadata resets on valid navigation.
Contract regression caught a fallback overriding API 405; fixed by letting the original router handle wrong methods. Known API wrong-method and unknown API 404 checks now pass (15 targeted tests).

items.title: Ручной ввод доставки не работает при сбое справочника городов
checks: 5 delivery regressions passed; manual addresses survive city/point directory failures, normal directory validation retained; TypeScript checked.

items.title: Переименование бренда разрывает связь с его товарами
checks: 12 brand/media API tests passed; brand rename updates product membership in the same transaction, preserves slug, rejects collisions; row locked against concurrent renames.

items.title: Номер выбранного отделения или поштомата теряется при оформлении
checks: 4 checkout regressions passed; selected point submits the full provider description including branch/locker number, not its short address.
End-to-end directory assertion now checks full branch number, matching the corrected provider name field.

items.title: Недоступные товары остаются в избранном без возможности очистки
checks: 2 collection regressions passed; missing items can be explicitly removed, all collections can be cleared, failures preserve saved IDs, requests cancelled on changes.

items.title: Временная ошибка quote сбрасывает выбранный промокод
checks: 5 checkout regressions passed; promo retained beyond prior 6-second expiry through 503 errors, explicit retry retains code, submission disabled while quote is invalid.

items.title: Сбой загрузки выдаётся за отсутствие бренда
checks: Brand page regression passed: 503 shows an error and retry, missing-brand state appears only after a successful empty response; typecheck and lint passed.

items.title: Выбор города клавиатурой падает после обновления подсказок
checks: 2 autocomplete regressions passed: shortened and reordered suggestions; selected references remain valid.

items.title: Отложить формы обращений и их зависимости
checks: 3 lead-form regressions passed; closed forms are unmounted and dynamically imported; main JavaScript reduced 453.97 to 345.46 KB, gzip 140.49 to 108.13 KB; build and lint passed.
Full frontend suite 118 passed; lazy-form regression allows 3 seconds for module import under concurrent test load while retaining mount/unmount checks.

items.title: Готовить размеры фото под карточку
checks: 321 backend and 94 frontend tests passed; original URLs retained, WebP sizes preserve alpha and ratio, stale variants ignored; storage transport reused by supplier imports.
Production sample thumbnails: 7,654 bytes vs original 23,456 bytes. Follow-up prevents larger derivatives and keeps full-size originals; 4 image regressions passed.
325 backend and 102 frontend tests passed. Batch processing now overlaps bounded uploads (max 8), permits 8 source workers with only 2 encoders; resumability and upload bounds tested.
3 visibility/gallery regressions passed; thumbnail URLs are assigned only when their images enter the viewport; fallback works without IntersectionObserver; typecheck/lint passed.

Production diagnosis: 20 thumbnails were simultaneously visible in wrapped mobile gallery; changed to a horizontally scrollable strip so only visible images compete with the main image; 3 regressions passed.

5 image regressions passed including concurrency bounds, fast resume without rewriting complete rows, and repair of missing gallery metadata without re-downloading originals. Upload concurrency configurable 1–32; encoders still limited to 2, product-scoped CLI reuses the same pipeline.

items.title: Уменьшить лишнюю работу выдачи и рекомендаций
checks: 65 backend regressions and 3 catalog UI tests passed; public lists load PRIMARY specifications only, detail reloads all sources, recommendation requests start on visibility; typecheck/lint passed.

items.title: Сократить повторную работу справочников и facets
checks: 110 cache/catalog/admin regressions passed; invalidation follows successful catalog commits, outages/corrupt values fall back to SQL, concurrent misses are coalesced. Full-catalog PostgreSQL/Redis benchmark: repeated directories/facets 1.0–1.8 ms with zero SQL queries; facets cold 26.1 ms.

items.title: Оптимизировать поиск на основании плана SQL
checks: PostgreSQL EXPLAIN on all 23,736 catalog products: search medians Hager 30.627 to 9.538 ms, ETIMAT 40.568 to 1.913 ms, partial SKU 28.147 to 0.249 ms; concurrent GIN index migration preserves query semantics.

items.title: Оставить глубокую пагинацию под наблюдением
checks: 55 catalog regressions and 90 PostgreSQL comparisons passed across all six sorts, first/deep/empty pages, brands and search; narrow-ID paging preserved every ordered result. EXPLAIN deep popular page 201.821 to 13.213 ms.

items.title: Начинать нужные запросы раньше при переходах
checks: 4 seed regressions passed; public API paths shared between transport/query options, parameter-aware seeds retain receipt time and exclude private data. Local compiled browser: home/product/section start with zero API fetches; catalog/brand need only filter facets, no duplicate initial product request.

items.title: Ограничить сетевое ожидание Redis для HTTP-запросов
checks: 11 settings/Redis tests passed; HTTP Redis connect/read bounded to one second by default, configurable within 10 seconds; blocking task queue remains unchanged.

items.title: Настроить реальные товарные подборки главной
checks: 2 homepage rail regressions passed; default selection now shows real catalog products without inventing popularity/badges, requests wait for visibility, errors show retry; typecheck/lint passed.
Browser suite updated to the actual catalog selection heading; fixture-based end-to-end flow covers the new default rail.

items.title: Проверка прод-сервисов включает одноразовые CLI-контейнеры
checks: Found during production verification with isolated media worker; shell syntax checked, one-off containers excluded while every regular instance is checked.
6 services healthy; public catalog OK; 200 A advisor returns null recommendation and specialist state.
6 services healthy; combined advisor returns six compatible breakers and cable capacity covers breaker nominal.
Production browser directory-outage scenario: no address errors, order POST attempted once and blocked, cart retained.
